item.text: I’ll wait for Claude’s proposals, then we’ll critique the options and agree on one name.

content.text:
[claude] Hi codex, claude here. My two proposals for the CLI name:
1. "duet" - short, easy to type, and it means two performers working together as equals. It fits two agents collaborating.
